traceability_matrix.requirement: Voyage plan must cover entire voyage from berth to berth
traceability_matrix.scenario: P1 Safety Critical - Voyage plan covers entire voyage from berth to berth

traceability_matrix.requirement: Bunker margin < 5% on arrival (propulsion failure risk, safety-critical)
traceability_matrix.scenario: P1 Safety Critical - Bunker margin < 5% on arrival

traceability_matrix.requirement: Bunker margin 5-15% on arrival (remedial action recommended)
traceability_matrix.scenario: P1 Safety Critical - Bunker margin exactly 15% on arrival
P1 Safety Critical - 24h pre-arrival notice for EU ports

traceability_matrix.requirement: FAL Form 1 (General Declaration) required for all vessel arrivals
traceability_matrix.scenario: PSC Detention Triggers - Missing or incomplete FAL Form 1

traceability_matrix.requirement: Voyage planning must include four stages: APPRAISAL, PLANNING, EXECUTION, and MONITOR
Route deviation must update ETA and be logged

coverage_gaps.gap: Missing validation of the four-stage planning process (Appraisal, Planning, Execution, Monitor)
coverage_gaps.recommendation: Add scenario: Verify system enforces/logs the four stages of voyage planning per IMO standards.

coverage_gaps.gap: Missing validation of ETA updates and logging during route deviation
coverage_gaps.recommendation: Add scenario: Trigger route deviation and verify automatic ETA recalculation and audit log entry.

executive_summary: All safety-critical (P1) and compliance (P2) requirements are fully covered, including PSC detention triggers. Operational gaps exist regarding the ISM-mandated planning stages and deviation logging.
recommendations: Implement test cases for the four-stage planning lifecycle to ensure ISM compliance.
Add functional tests for route deviation logging to prevent audit findings during PSC inspections.
